summary: Post-restructure verification of LocDoc (Vite React 19 frontend + minimal FastAPI backend). Ran pytest against /api/health, /api/, CORS preflight — all 3 pass. Ran Playwright coverage across Home, Doctors listing, DoctorDetail (dr-anjali-rao), Medicines, Lab tests, Login, Register facility, About, and SalesChat visibility. All 12 requested feature areas verified working with zero console errors/warnings.
verified_flows: Home / renders hero, trust metrics, service pillars, live waitlist, specialties, top clinics, verification, facility preview/reviews, register business, CTA — all keywords present, 0 console errors
Hero search: 4 tabs render; switching to 'Lab tests' updates placeholder to 'Search tests or labs'; submitting query 'blood test' navigates to /lab-tests?q=blood%20test
/doctors lists doctor cards (12 'View profile' ghost buttons rendered)

/doctors/dr-anjali-rao: avatar hero, verified badge, sticky booking sidebar with fee, exactly 14 .dd-punct__bar elements (punctuality chart), NMC/ABDM/State council text present, slot day columns rendered, clicking a slot opens booking modal running OnboardingTracker (Slot held RUNNING → Sending OTP QUEUED → Confirmed QUEUED) — verified via screenshot
/medicines and /lab-tests each render distinct SVG illustration in hero (pill bottle / lab flask visible in screenshot)
/login: 5 role chips rendered; clicking 'Hospital' changes heading from 'Log in to LocDoc' → 'Facility login'
/register/hospital, /register/pharmacy load with form; success screen path uses OnboardingTracker (component reused)

SalesChat visibility rule works correctly: HIDDEN on / and /doctors; VISIBLE on /doctors/:id and /register/pharmacy. Chat pill opens .sc__panel; 8 quick-reply chips present; clicking a chip produces 2 messages (user + canned agent reply) after typing indicator
Theme toggle in navbar switches html data-theme from 'light' → 'dark' (both themes visually consistent in screenshots)
Backend GET /api/health → 200 {status:'ok', service:'locdoc-api', db, time}; GET /api/ → 200; CORS preflight → 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): /app/frontend/.env sets REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL but the app is Vite (react 19) — Vite only exposes vars prefixed VITE_ via import.meta.env. Currently frontend makes NO backend calls so this is inert, but if any client-side call to backend is ever added, rename to VITE_BACKEND_URL (or add both). Not a bug today, just a footgun for future.

ENHANCEMENT: There are ZERO data-testid attributes across /app/frontend/src. Testing worked via stable class names ('.sc', '.dd-punct__bar', '.sc__toggle', '.sc__panel', '.sc__chip', role chips by text). Adding data-testid on Hero search tabs/input/submit, SalesChat pill/panel/chips/send, DoctorDetail slot buttons, and booking modal steps would harden future automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: MongoDB client is instantiated eagerly and _db is unused by any handler — since the app has no persistence today, consider deferring the client creation or removing until a real endpoint needs it (currently only adds surface area for boot failures).
frontend uses Vite but env file is named REACT_APP_*; either rename to VITE_* or drop the file to avoid confusion.
DoctorDetail.jsx uses Math.random-derived (via useMemo seed) punctuality history — deterministic per id which is good; no issue.
SalesChat pathname visibility check uses startsWith('/register/') and regex on '/doctors/:id' — verified working; would benefit from a data-testid='sales-chat' on the root .sc div.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no auth backend; all form submissions are simulated with setTimeout
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is Vite + React 19 + react-router-dom v7, no real API integration (only /api/health on backend). Playwright selectors that work: SalesChat root '.sc', toggle '.sc__toggle', panel '.sc__panel', chips '.sc__chip'; DoctorDetail punctuality bars '.dd-punct__bar' (14), booking sidebar '.dd-book', hero '.dd-hero'; HowItWorks '#how-it-works' or '.how'; hero search has a single input (no type attr) with dynamic placeholder driven by active tab. Console clean on every route. Zero data-testid attributes — add them if you need robust selectors.
